verdict.rationale: The evidence pack mentions Vercel's CDN only in passing. Images are resized and served from the CDN (vercel-docs-22), and static pages can be regenerated on a schedule or on demand without a full rebuild (vercel-docs-21), which implies cached static delivery. Missing for 10: explicit docs on a global edge network/PoPs, edge caching of static assets and cache-control behavior, any performance claims or benchmarks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
